title: Rattan Lal v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Rattan Lal v. State of Punjab, AIR 1965 SC 444
content.holding: Article 20(1) prohibits retrospective enhancement of penalties, but does not prohibit beneficial ex-post facto laws that reduce or mitigate punishment.
content.relevance: Permissibility of beneficial ex-post facto criminal laws.
